doodle.reason: Captures the focused energy of building dev tools and the quick, surgical iterations Erik values

headline: Surgical moves in Stockholm
narrative: Quiet week focused on Cursor tooling—cursor-commands and shipflow getting the attention they deserve. Coding activity down but intentional, working on the infrastructure that makes building software easier. Meanwhile, French indie pop seeps into the headphones, a new sound for a familiar rhythm of iteration.

sections.title: Cursor infrastructure
sections.content: Deep work on cursor-commands and shipflow, the tools that enable point-and-click editing for Next.js. Contributing back to the ecosystem with a PR, iterating on the vision of staying in flow without leaving context. 24 commits tell a story of focused refinement, not frantic activity.

sections.title: Building in public
sections.content: Recent posts about comparing agents in context, surgical moves over sweeping rewrites, and the joy of flow state with parallel agents. Quiet this week on X, but the philosophy remains clear: you set the vision, agents do the execution.

sections.title: New sounds
sections.content: French indie pop discovery—Videoclub finding their way into the rotation alongside dream pop staples. Tame Impala and Beach House still holding steady, but there's exploration happening in the margins.

footer: Overcast Stockholm evening, 9°C. The city dims early in December, but the screen stays bright—building tools that make building easier, one surgical move at a time.
